deadEnd.details: Observed 2026-08-25. The store is unambiguously Shopify (serves meta[name=shopify-checkout-api-token] plus cdn.shopify.com references, and /products.json responds), but the cart permalink GET /cart/<variantId>:1 redirects to hackerboxes.com/account/login instead of to /checkouts/. Tested with variant 43712574980185 ($59.00, in stock). No unattended guest-card path. This is a per-store customer-accounts-required setting, not a platform limitation.

notes: Contrast case: same platform and same cart-permalink route as onetreeplanted.org and heatonist.com, which both land straight on the payment page. Recorded so an agent does not spend a session rediscovering the wall. Determined over plain HTTP only; no checkout session was driven and no card data was involved.
